summary: Router 0.42.13 closes TM-07's next action 'limit enrollment to known networks' (ADR-0136, proposed). New optional router.agent_enrollment_networks (list of CIDR; absent/empty = any address as before); config.py parses each entry with values.ip_network (ipaddress reference parser, strict=False, exception-ok at that boundary) and refuses a non-list or a non-network. Traced B3: the tunnel endpoint (registry.py) authenticates the hello (Ed25519 signature over the nonce) first, computes the key fingerprint and calls enrollment_denial(fp, request.remote) before upsert_hello; a known fingerprint (approved, pending, revoked) passes as before, so approved agents keep connecting from any address and revoked ones still get their revoked status. For an unknown fingerprint the network check now runs before the pending-capacity and per-address admission checks, so a refused key uses no admission slot and is never stored; the agent gets the status message with the reason and close code 1008, the existing refusal path. values.in_networks reads the peer text with values.ip_address (explicit failure -> outside), maps IPv4-mapped IPv6 to IPv4 and compares only same-version networks. request.remote is the TCP peer: behind a reverse proxy it is the proxy (documented). No exception path added outside the parser boundary.

tests.evidence: 5 tests: CIDR, single address and host-bit parsing, bad values refused; inside/outside/IPv4-mapped/unreadable/missing matching; without networks any address enrolls; a new key from outside is refused with the reason and uses no admission slot (rejected case), inside (IPv4/IPv6) enrolls; approved and pending keys reconnect from outside; Config.load takes the list and refuses a string, a non-network and a number. With values.py, config.py and registry.py from origin/main 4 errors.

tests.command: every python test/... and tools/... command of all workflows in .github/workflows/, except run_tests.py and check_public_changes (run separately); plus ruff check . and router.py --check router/config.example.yaml --pure
tests.evidence: 98 commands, 0 failed; includes selftest_security (enrollment caps unchanged), selftest_agent_revocation, check_control_flow.
run after staging this record; documentation addresses (RFC 5737/3849) only.

limitations: Behind a reverse proxy the router sees the proxy's address; the list must then name the proxy.
Plausibility checks on reports of approved agents (TM-07's other action) are not added.
No wire-level test over the real tunnel endpoint for the network refusal; the unit test calls enrollment_denial, which the endpoint calls with request.remote (unchanged call site).
